body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. Code looks good to me.

Some issues I noticed (not strictly related to this PR, but they impact RGBA4444 and DDS usability overall):

- Textures appear too bright in 3D when using the RGBA4444 format (likely a missing sRGB conversion):

### RGBA8

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0b7e6795-7789-44ca-83dd-72e0cb4f7c61)

### RGBA4444

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/519e8b73-cb81-4ce5-b83f-578262d5ee53)

The issue goes away if you check **Albedo Texture Force sRGB** on the material.

- DDS files don't appear when using **Quick Load** in the inspector – you need to use **Load** instead.
